stages.label: Exchange opens
stages.narrative: Thousands of modeled neighbors begin requesting and offering everyday cables through nearby hubs.

stages.label: Cables circulate
stages.narrative: People carry named cables into hubs for drop-off and away from hubs after pickup.

stages.label: Supply meets demand
stages.narrative: Global and per-hub boards expose stock, new requests, incoming supply, fulfilled pickups, and waiting demand.

stages.label: The pseudo-year rolls
stages.narrative: The continuous exchange completes all 365 modeled days with every cable movement and inventory change balanced.

seeds.label: Everyday cable exchange
seeds.description: A full pseudo-year of neighbors sharing the charging, display, network, audio, and power cables they need.
seeds.missionText: Run the 365-day community cable exchange and show live hub supply, demand, pickups, and drop-offs.

seeds.label: Device upgrade cycle
seeds.description: A different deterministic year shifts which everyday cable types enter hubs and which are requested.
seeds.missionText: Run the device-upgrade pseudo-year through the same community exchange.

seeds.label: Move-in cycle
seeds.description: A different deterministic year changes the people, hubs, locations, and cable trips that become active each day.
seeds.missionText: Run the move-in pseudo-year and inspect local cable balance at each hub.

seeds.label: Office clean-out cycle
seeds.description: A different deterministic year circulates spare display, network, USB, audio, and power cables through the same neighborhood hubs.
seeds.missionText: Run the office clean-out pseudo-year and watch spare cables return to neighborhood use.
